text:
maria.g: quick sync — need to lock timeline for the marketplace listing that includes our SI partners + the new edge/hardware partner. embargo target is Tue 2026-05-12 09:00 PT.
ashley: copy freeze for landing page is 2026-04-28 EOD, is that still doable from content?
jordan: SI onboarding doc will be ready 2026-04-20, but we need final API contract by 2026-04-15. those two dates are linked.
samir: HW partner (EdgeCon) asked for co-brand SKU + image assets. they can deliver high-res by 2026-04-22 if we confirm specs today.
maria.g: @samir add exact image dimensions and alt copy here. ops needs a list to onboard tenants into the staging catalog.
ops-bot: Reminder: Staging tenant provisioning window closes 2026-04-25 17:00 PT for the May marketplace publish.
kayla: design note — prefer 1920x1080 hero and 1024x512 thumbnail. can do localized variants for FR/DE by 2026-05-04 if we hand off strings by 2026-04-29.
design-lead: also need approval on co-brand lockup by 2026-04-23. approvers: @maria.g, @ashley, EdgeCon marketing.
ashley: press assets — draft blog and press release first pass out 2026-04-26. press embargo text should NOT include partner pricing. confirm?
jordan: confirmed, pricing removed. SI quote placeholders look good but we need legal signoff on partner quotes by 2026-04-27.
maria.g: proposed mini runbook (quick):
```
- 2026-04-15: API contract freeze
- 2026-04-20: SI onboarding doc published
- 2026-04-22: EdgeCon assets delivered
- 2026-04-23: co-brand lockup approval
- 2026-04-25: staging tenant provisioning cutoff
- 2026-04-26: blog + PR draft
- 2026-04-28: landing page copy freeze
- 2026-05-04: localized assets ready
- 2026-05-12: embargo lift & announce
```

samir: looks fine. add a fallback policy: if EdgeCon misses asset date, we publish with generic HW hero and update post-launch.
kayla: can we get a one-day buffer for localization? move handoff to 04-28 -> then localization by 05-05?
maria.g: ok adjust: localization complete 2026-05-05. I will update runbook.
ops-bot: NOTE: If any tenants require private VPC onboarding, allow +48 hours for provisioning.
ashley: who owns the customer-facing integration guide link? we should include it on the landing page. @jordan?
jordan: yes, I’ll own it. will drop link to docs on final page and add SI contact block.
design-lead: small accessibility check — ensure all images have alt text and CTA contrast meets AA. can review by 2026-05-06.
maria.g: vendor comms: I’ll send a short email to EdgeCon + three SI leads today with the updated timeline and asset checklist. drafting now: https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE
ashley: +1. Also set up 30-min dry-run with comms + legal on 2026-05-07 to verify embargo wording.
samir: can ops confirm cadence for canary rollout to dedicated customers post-launch? want to avoid routing thrash.
ops-bot: Canary rollout plan: enable for 10% of dedicated tenants for 48 hours post-launch, auto-roll to 50% if no errors > 0.1% for 3h.
maria.g: perfect. next steps: @samir to confirm EdgeCon asset acceptance today, @jordan to publish SI guide by 04-20, @ashley to schedule comms dry-run. I’ll send the partner email in 30m.
kayla: noted, design will queue localization and alt-text tasks.
ashley: thanks everyone — will update calendar invites. :thumbsup:
